title: Settings
glow.title: Glow effect
glow.desc: Enable or disable the glow effect surrounding banners, as well as the hover-triggered glow effect on anime cards.
autoUpdate.title: Update episodes on Anilist automatically
autoUpdate.desc: If turned on, {{app}} will automatically update the episode on Anilist when more than 80% of the episode is watched.

hoverCard.title: Popup when hovering over anime cards
hoverCard.desc1: Enable or disable the popup when hovering over anime cards.
player.title: External media player path
player.desc: Set the path to the executable file of the external media player.

shortcuts.navDesc: Navigate between pages using Alt + Arrow Left/Right
